title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description: About Us BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we're looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.What You'll Do As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.More specifically, in this role you will: Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs) Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updatesWhat We're Looking For 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta) 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients) Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationshipsWhat This Role Is NOT This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.Time Commitment Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.Pay $3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.If you're passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente). Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI). Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos. title: Strategic Customer Success Manager

Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities. Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.Join Client! Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it's an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity. If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let's build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.ComThe Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.Purpose of This PositionAs a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent. You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.Core ResponsibilityServe as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions: "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"\ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"Main Objectives1. Content Execution & Copywriting Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for: -Websites -Social media captions and post copy -Email campaigns -Campaign and promotional assets Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text) Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad. Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness. Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.2. Strategy & Project Management Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring: -Consistency in writing style -Variety in content types -A range of related, engaging topics3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging. When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms. When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans. Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives. Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints. Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative. Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.5. Brand Advocacy Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content. Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution. Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.Reporting Relationship This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging. Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity. Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand's voice, positioning, and goals. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.2. Content Quality & Accuracy Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose. Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.3. Project Delivery Timeliness Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines. Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken EnglishReady for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Analista Hubspot
description: A Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) é líder global em serviços de TI, consultoria & soluções de negócios com uma grande rede de centros de inovação & entrega.Fomos reconhecidos como um Global Top Employer e nossa capacidade de fornecer carreiras holísticas de longo prazo baseadas em aprendizado contínuo impulsionado por nosso ecossistema de aprendizagem digital nos ajuda a desenvolver os melhores talentos!E convidamos você a fazer parte da nossa equipe!Sobre a posição: Buscamos um(a)Analista HubSpotpara atuar na administração, evolução e sustentação de todo o ecossistema HubSpot — incluindo CRM, Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub e/ou Operations Hub.Se você domina CRM, automações inteligentes e melhoria contínua de processos, esta vaga pode ser perfeita para você! O profissional será peça-chave entre Marketing, Vendas, Customer Success/Atendimento e TI, garantindo que o HubSpot funcione de forma estratégica e eficiente.Responsabilidades: Gestão e Administração do HubSpot Configurar e administrar usuários, permissões, equipes e propriedades. Estruturar e manter pipelines de vendas e atendimento com SLAs e regras bem definidas. Criar e garantir boas práticas, governança e padronização do uso do CRM.Automação e Processos: Criar workflows, regras de roteamento e automações inteligentes. Implementar lead scoring, nutrição de leads e handoff entre Marketing e Vendas. Automatizar comunicações e processos de pós-venda/CS.Dados e Performance: Assegurar qualidade de dados, deduplicação e normalizações. Monitorar indicadores de funil e produtividade das equipes. Identificar gargalos e propor melhorias baseadas em dados.Relatórios e Inteligência: Construir dashboards e relatórios para Marketing, Vendas e liderança. Acompanhar métricas como CAC, MQL/SQL, conversões, receita por canal e churn/retention. Criar visões executivas recorrentes para suporte à gestão.Integrações e Evolução da Plataforma: Apoiar integrações com ferramentas como Microsoft 365, Salesforce, RD Station, WhatsApp, telefonia, ERPs e outras. Colaborar com TI/Engenharia em integrações via API e Webhooks. Documentar processos, apoiar testes e releases.Treinamento e Suporte: Treinar usuários, criar playbooks e dar suporte de 1o/2o nível. Estimular a adoção e padronização dos processos no CRM.O que buscamos: Experiência prática com HubSpot (CRM + ao menos 1 Hub). Vivência em criação de workflows, listas, pipelines e propriedades. Conhecimento de processos de funil (Marketing, Vendas ou CS). Capacidade analítica e habilidade com dashboards e métricas. Excelente comunicação e trabalho colaborativo.Diferenciais: Certificações HubSpot (Admin, Marketing, Sales, Reporting, Operations). Experiência com Operations Hub e governança de dados. Noções de integrações via API, Webhooks, Zapier/Make. Conhecimento de lead scoring, attribution, lifecycle stages e ABM. Experiência com GA4, Power BI/Looker, telefonia/WhatsApp e plataformas de mídia.Modelo de contratação: CLT Full + BenefíciosBenefícios TCS – Brasil: Plano de Saúde Planos Odontológico Seguro de Vida Vale Transporte Vale Refeição/Alimentação Auxílio Creche Gympass TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados Parceria com SESC Reembolso de Certificações Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo Oportunidade de experiência internacional Parceria de descontos com Universidades e escolas de idiomas Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuitaOperamos em escala global, com diversas bases de talentos representando 156 nacionalidades, em 55 países. Na Tata Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, sempre trabalhamos pela equidade. Isso se traduz em Gênero, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQIA+, Religião, Raça, Diversidade de experiências e Etnia, ou seja, todas as nossas vagas são trabalhadas com esses princípios.

Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.Estamos buscando um Analista Inteligência em projetos de IA e Data Science para atuação em cliente Atos.Cientista de Dados Sênior com experiência comprovada em projetos de IA aplicada, inglês avançado (no mínimo para compreensão de leitura e audição), capacidade de liderar projetos de forma independente e experiência no desenvolvimento e supervisão de atividades em todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de IA (do pré-processamento de dados à implantação em produção). Experiência desenvolvendo projetos com IA Generativa, Experiência com projetos em ambiente de nuvem, Habilidades de programação avançadas em Python, SQL e NoSQLAtuação remota.Benefícios: Plano de saúde Plano odontológico Wellhub (Gympass) Espaço Saúde - promove a saúde e bem-estar aos nossos colaboradores, dando suporte com atendimento médico ( presencial ou online) para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida. description:

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)
description: No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional. Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual) Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância. Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento. Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.Requisitos necessários Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.Diferenciais Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.Perfil esperado Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta. Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados. Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.#SeleçãoSBF #VempraSBF
